y-m-26-03.title: Maxaa isbeddela marka wax dheeraad ah laga ogaado bar-dhoofyada?
y-m-26-03.topic: Sifooyinka bar-dhoofyada afargeesoodyada, iyo aqoonsiga afargeesoodyada
y-m-26-03.goal: Sharax, adigoo ku xidhaya shuruudaha, sida go'aanka ah in afargeesood yahay afargeesood qumman ama laba-jibaaran u beddelmo marka macluumaadka ku saabsan bar-dhoofyada la sii daro hal-hal, oo ku xaqiiji tusaalayaal aad naftaada samaysay in macluumaadka ugu horreeya oo kaligiis uusan ku filnayn.
y-m-26-03.material: Labada bar-dhoof ee afargeesoodka ABCD waa AC iyo BD. Afargeesood qumman waa afargeesood afartiisa xagal oo dhan yihiin xagallo qumman, afargeesood isle'eg-dhinac waa afargeesood afartiisa dhinac oo dhan dherer isku mid ah leh, laba-jibaaranna waa afargeesood afartiisa xagal oo dhan yihiin xagallo qumman afartiisa dhinac oo dhanna dherer isku mid ah leh. Mala awaal inaad hore u taqaanid in 'afargeesood labadiisa bar-dhoof is-badhin ay yihiin isbarbar-dhig'. Dhammaan afargeesoodyada waxaa loo tixgeliyaa afargeesoodyo kor u soo baxsan (afargeesoodyo aan qayb gudaha u dhacsan lahayn).

y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.0: Macluumaad kasta dib u qor sidii sifo ee 'bar-dhoofyada' afargeesoodka oo isbarbar dhig sifooyinka bar-dhoofyada afargeesood qumman, isbarbar-dhig, iyo afargeesood isle'eg-dhinac.

y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ma lagu odhan karaa afargeesoodka ABCD waa afargeesood qumman?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Afargeesoodyada bar-dhoofyadoodu isle'eg yihiin waxaa ku jira qaar aan ahayn afargeesood qumman (tusaale, trapezoid labadiisa lug dherer isku mid ah leh). y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda ma lagu odhan karaa afargeesoodka ABCD waa afargeesood qumman?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Haddii bar-dhoofyadu is-badhiyaan, waa isbarbar-dhig. Isbarbar-dhigga ABCD, marka la isbarbar dhigo saddex xagalka ABD iyo saddex xagalka DCA, AB = DC, AD = DA (wadaag), BD = CA, sidaa darteed way is-waafaqaan (SSS), ∠A = ∠D-na. Maadaama AB ∥ DC, ∠A + ∠D = 180°, sidaa darteed ∠A = ∠D = 90°. Sidaa darteed waa afargeesood qumman.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Waxaan ogaan karnaa oo keliya inuu yahay isbarbar-dhig oo weli ma ognin inuu yahay afargeesood qumman
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Waa sax inuu yahay isbarbar-dhig. Laakiin waad sii isticmaali kartaa 'AC = BD' ee aad bilowga ogayd. Maxaa isbeddelaya marka labada macluumaad la isla isticmaalo?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Maaha afar-gees qumman laakiin waa rhombus
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Rhombus, waxaad u baahan tahay macluumaadka ah afarta dhinac isle'eg yihiin. Ilaa hadda macluumaad ku saabsan dhererrada dhinacyada ma jiro.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Waa afar-gees qumman. Waa parallelogram oo labada dhidib dhererkoodu isku mid yahay, sidaa darteed afarta xagal way isle'eg yihiin
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Waa laba-jibbaar. Sababtoo ah dhidibyadu way is badh-kala-qaybiyaan
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Si uu laba-jibbaar u noqdo, waxaad u baahan tahay macluumaadka dheeraadka ah ee afarta dhinac isle'eg yihiin. Badh-kala-qaybinta oo keliya waxay kuu sheegaysaa ilaa parallelogram oo keliya.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Waxa ugu dambeeyay ee la bartay: labada dhidib way kulmaan si toosan. (AC ⊥ BD)

y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Afar-gees oo dhidibyadiisu is badh-kala-qaybiyaan, haddii dhidibyadu toosan yihiin, waa rhombus (afar dhinac oo isle'eg). Horey ayuu u ahaa afar-gees qumman, sidaa darteed afarta xagal dhammaantood waa xagallo qumman afarta dhinac na waa isle'eg yihiin, sidaa darteed waa laba-jibbaar. 'Afar-gees qumman' ee tallaabadii hore weli waa sax, laakiin macluumaadka cusubi wuxuu magaca ka dhigay mid ka sii gaar ah.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Rhombus sidoo kale ma aha erey khaldan (way is badh-kala-qaybiyaan oo toosan yihiin). Laakiin haddii aad sidoo kale ku darto macluumaadkii tallaabadii hore ee ahaa inuu yahay afar-gees qumman, waxaa jira magac ka sii faahfaahsan.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Odhanshaha afar-gees qumman ma aha khalad. Laakiin ma isticmaalin 'toosan' ee cusub ee hadda la helay. Waa maxay parallelogram dhidibyadiisu toosan yihiin?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Waa parallelogram laakiin ma aha afar-gees qumman
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Waxaad tallaabadii hore ku baratay inuu yahay afar-gees qumman. Macluumaad cusub ma rogi karo gunaanad hore.

y-m-26-03.s.s2.prompt: Aan naftayada ku hubinno in marka macluumaadka koowaad oo keliya la ogyahay (AC = BD), laga yaabo inuusan ahayn afar-gees qumman. Hawshan, waxaad ka shaqaysaa kaliya haddii, marka dhowr shaxan ay ku uruursan yihiin hal geeso, xagallada bar ku wareegsan ay samaynayaan saxda 360° iyadoo aan daloolo ama is dulsaar jirin. y-m-26-01.title: Haddii aad ogtahay laba dhinac iyo hal xagal, ma saddex xagalku waa la go'aamiyay mid?
y-m-26-01.topic: Shuruudaha is-waafaqidda saddex xagalaha (laba dhinac iyo hal xagal)
y-m-26-01.goal: Adigoo naftaada samaynaya tusaalayaal lid ku ah muuji in sheegashada 'laba dhinac iyo hal xagal ayaa isle'eg' laga yaabo inaanay run ahayn iyadoo ku xiran meesha xagalku yaal, oo go'aami waxa kale ee loo baahan yahay si loo hubiyo in saddex xagalada is-waafaqaan.
y-m-26-01.material:
Jihu wuxuu yidhi, “Saddex xagalka ABC iyo saddex xagalka DEF, haddii AC=DF=10cm, BC=EF=6.5cm, iyo ∠A=∠D, markaa labada saddex xagal waa is-waafaqaan!”

Si aan u tijaabino, waxaan saddex xagalka ABC dhigay shayaadka isu-duwidda (hal laba jibaaran waa 1cm). A waa asalka (0, 0) C-na waa (8, 6). Markaas AC=10cm. B waa dhibic ku taal dhidibka x, midigta A (isku-duwaha x-keedu waa togan yahay). ∠A waa xagalka ay sameeyaan qaybta AB ee dhidibka x iyo qaybta AC. Waxaan saddex xagalka DEF ku dhigi karnaa si la mid ah si AC=DF iyo ∠A=∠D. Hadda hel dhibicda B oo BC=6.5cm.

y-m-26-04.material: Waxaa jira baro B iyo C oo ku yaal cidhifka balli, sidaa darteed BC si toos ah looma cabbiri karo. y-m-26-02.title: Xaggee ayaa dhibaatadu ku jirtaa caddaynta?
y-m-26-02.topic: Sifooyinka saddex xagalada labo-dhinac-isle'eg iyo khaladaadka caddaynta
y-m-26-02.goal: Hel khaladka ah isticmaalidda gebagebada la muujinayo oo caddayn ahaan caddaynta, oo go'aami in lagu saxi karo siyaabo kala duwan si shuruudda is-waafaqidda si sax ah u dhacdo.
y-m-26-02.material: Seohyeon wuxuu doonayaa inuu caddeeyo 'Saddex xagalka ABC, haddii AB = AC, markaas ∠B = ∠C'. AB = AC waa qaadashada ∠B = ∠C-na waa gebagebada la caddaynayo. Hoos waxaa ku qoran caddaynta Seohyeon qoray. Akhri adigoo kala saaraya qaadashada iyo gebagebada. Dhibicda M waa dhibic ku taal dhinaca BC. (Sawir ma jiro. Mala awaal saddex xagalka ABC oo qayb laga sawiray bar-dhoofka A ilaa dhinaca BC.)
y-m-26-02.thinking.0: Kala qaybinta xariiqyada caddaynta qaadashada/gebagebada si loo helo khaladka
y-m-26-02.thinking.1: Isbarbar dhigidda dhowr siyaabood oo saxan oo lagu saxo
y-m-26-02.prereq.0: Macnaha saddex xagalka labo-dhinac-isle'eg (saddex xagal leh laba dhinac oo dherer isle'eg ah)
y-m-26-02.prereq.1: Shuruudaha is-waafaqidda saddex xagalka SSS, SAS, iyo shuruudda is-waafaqidda saddex xagalka qumman RHS
y-m-26-02.s.s1.prompt: Seohyeon wuxuu qoray kuwa soo socda, isagoo leh wuxuu caddaynayaa 'labada xagal ee salka saddex xagalka labo-dhinac-isle'eg ah cabbirkoodu waa isle'eg yahay'. Dooro xariiqda ay adag tahay in loo aqbalo sidii caddayn.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.0: Xariiq kasta, calaamadee in ay isticmaalayso 'waxa la bixiyay (qaadashada)' ama 'waxa la muujinayo (gebagebada)'.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.1: Saddexda arrimood ee xariiqda 3 u kala saar in mid kastaa yahay qaadasho, wax laga helay xariiq hore, ama wixii la rabay in la caddeeyo.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.0: Saddex xagalka ABC, AB = AC. (La muujinayo: ∠B = ∠C)
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.1: Ha ahaato M barta dhexe ee dhinaca BC oo ku xidh A iyo M qayb. Markaas BM = CM.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.2: Saddex xagalka ABM iyo saddex xagalka ACM, AB = AC, ∠B = ∠C (xagallada salka saddex xagalka labo-dhinac-isle'eg), AM-na waa wadaag.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.3: Sidaa darteed saddex xagalka ABM iyo saddex xagalka ACM way is-waafaqaan.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.4: Saddex xagalada is-waafaqa xagallada isku-habboon cabbirkoodu waa isle'eg yahay, sidaa darteed ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.explain: Xariiqda 3, ∠B = ∠C horey ayaa loo qoray sidii inay xaqiiqo tahay. Taasi waa gebagebada caddayntu doonayso inay muujiso. Natiijo ahaan, is-waafaqidda xariiqda 4 sidoo kale aasaas ma leh (AB, ∠B, AM maaha laba dhinac iyo xagalka u dhexeeya), xariiqda 5-na waxay ku dhammaanaysaa gebagebo ah ku celinta wixii bilowga la qoray.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.prompt: Waxaad rabtaa inaad saxdo caddaynta Seohyeon. Marka la beddelayo habka lagu muujiyo is-waafaqidda xariiqda 3, dooro dhammaan siyaabaha caddaynta sax ka dhigaya.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.0: Hab kasta, hubi in saddexda arrimood ee la isticmaalay ay dhammaantood yihiin qaadashooyin, ama si toos ah uga imanayaan sida dhibicda M loo doortay.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig in ay leedahay qaabka la jaan qaadaya shuruudda is-waafaqidda (SSS, SAS, RHS). Hubi sidoo kale haddii doorasho kasta ay isticmaasho gebagebada ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.a: Qaado M sidii cagta toosanka laga bilaabo A ilaa BC oo isbarbar dhig adigoo isticmaalaya AB = AC, AM wadaag, ∠AMB = ∠AMC = 90°
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.b: Qor ∠B = ∠C oo ku dar in tani sax tahay sababtoo ah sidaas ayay u muuqataa sawirka
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.b: In sidaas ay u muuqato sawirka maaha aasaas caddayn. Caddayntu waxay muujisaa sababta ay sidaas u muuqato.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.c: Qaado M sidii dhibicda halka u-qaybiyaha ∠A ku kulmo BC oo isbarbar dhig adigoo isticmaalaya AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM wadaag
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.d: Qor in saddex xagalada ABM iyo ACM is-waafaqaan sababtoo ah baaxadahoodu waa isle'eg yihiin, ka dibna qor in xagallada isku-habboon isle'eg yihiin
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.d: Xitaa haddii baaxaduhu isle'eg yihiin, qaabab way kala duwanaan karaan (tusaale, afargeesood oo ballac iyo dherer kala duwan leh). Baaxad isle'eg oo keliya ma ka dhigto is-waafaqid.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.e: Qaado M sidii barta dhexe ee BC oo isbarbar dhig adigoo isticmaalaya AB = AC, BM = CM, AM wadaag
y-m-26-02.s.s2.explain: e waa is-waafaqaan sababtoo ah saddexda dhinac waa isle'eg yihiin (SSS), c sababtoo ah laba dhinac iyo xagalka u dhexeeya waa isle'eg yihiin (SAS), a-na sababtoo ah bar-dhoofka iyo hal dhinac oo kale oo saddex xagal qumman ah waa isle'eg yihiin (RHS). Hal habna ma qorto ∠B = ∠C hore; ∠B = ∠C waxay ka helaan is-waafaqidda.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.prompt: Qor farriin ay u sheegto Seohyeon. Dheh sababta caddaynta asalka ah aan loogu odhan karin way muujisay 'xagallada salka waa isle'eg yihiin', oo qor sida loo saxo adigoo isticmaalaya mid ka mid ah siyaabaha kor ku xusan.

y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Habka aad ku saxday, ma saddexda arrimood ee shuruudda is-waafaqidda dhammaantood waa la bixiyay, mise way ka yimaadaan sida dhibicda M loo doortay?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.0: Xariiqda 3 horey ayay u isticmaashay ∠B = ∠C. Taasi waa gebagebada la caddaynayo, sidaa darteed ma ahaan karto aasaas. Waad saxi kartaa adigoo isticmaalaya is-waafaqidda SSS iyo qaadashada AB = AC, BM = CM oo ka timaadda M inay tahay barta dhexe, iyo AM wadaagga.

Haddii aad dhibicda M qaadato adigoo isticmaalaya u-qaybiyaha ∠A oo aad isticmaasho is-waafaqidda SAS iyadoo la adeegsanayo AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM wadaag, uma baahnid inaad hore u qaadato ∠B = ∠C.

y-m-26-05.title: Ma samayn karnaa saddex-xagallo aag 12 ah siyaabo badan?

y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka fikir sida dheer ee dhererku ay tahay inuu noqdo si aagga uu u noqdo 12 marka aad AB u aragto sida salka saddex-xagalka ABP.

y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.c: Baraha xariijintan ku yaal waxay leeyihiin masaafooyin kala duwan AB, sidaa darteed dhererradu way kala duwan yihiin. Aagagga way kala duwanaadaan.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.d: Baraha ku yaal xariijinta isbarbar socota AB oo 4cm ka fog AB
